About the College
Simen Chapari College was established in 1994 through the collective efforts of the Simen Chapori community, who recognized the growing need for an institute of higher studies. With an increasing number of students completing secondary education, and a shared belief in education as a catalyst for social change, the community came together to create this institution.
The founding vision was to make higher education accessible to all, especially those from economically disadvantaged backgrounds who might otherwise be deprived of advanced learning opportunities. Senior citizens of the locality championed the idea that education alone could bring about meaningful social transformation while promoting cultural preservation and human values.
